divergence_exceptions.reason: Frontmatter hooks: block's command paths are necessarily copy-specific: the canonical plugins/plugin-devkit/ copy is distributed and installed into other users' own projects, so it uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (tracks wherever the plugin is actually installed); the .claude/ mirror copy is never distributed (only used in-repo for pre-packaging dogfooding), so it uses ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} with this repo's own path (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is confirmed-broken for a project-level skill with no enclosing plugin, and a bare relative path is unsafe -- hook handlers run in the session's cwd, not the skill's own directory). Whole-file exception: only this hooks: block differs between the two copies, everything else stays identical.

Frontmatter hooks: block's command path is necessarily copy-specific, same reason as marketplace-development above: the canonical plugins/workmanagement-kit/ copy is distributed and uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; the .claude/ mirror copy is never distributed (in-repo dogfooding only) and uses ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} with this repo's own .claude/skills/ path, because ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is empty for a skill loaded from the mirror. The same reason covers the plugin scripts this skill runs: its allowed-tools grants and body paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ in the canonical copy, which is empty for a skill loaded from the mirror, so the mirror copy uses ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/scripts/ (the mirrored scripts live there). Whole-file exception: only the hook command line and the ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ paths differ between the two copies, everything else stays identical, so a later edit to either copy must be applied to both by hand (regenerate the mirror from the canonical file with those replacements).

Names the splitter script by its ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/ path in the canonical copy; that variable is empty for a skill loaded from the .claude/ mirror, so the mirror copy uses ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/scripts/, where the mirrored script lives (same reason as the SKILL.md entry above). Whole-file exception: only that script path differs between the two copies, so a later edit to either copy must be applied to both by hand.
